description: This file contains utility functions for working with JSON files, path normalization, executing test reports with Vitest, and processing test results. It serves as a helper module for test report generation and analysis in a JavaScript testing environment.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Replaces OS-specific path separators with forward slashes for normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a given path into a repository-relative normalized path.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from disk.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file, returns a fallback on failure.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes and writes a JavaScript object as JSON to a file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Runs Vitest test runner with JSON output and returns the report file path.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes a Vitest JSON report to extract file durations and test counts.
